name: Unified e-visa / tourist visa (Category C)

requirement_groups.name: Eligible-nationality e-visa or consular tourist visa

requirements.blocker_text: The unified e-visa (introduced August 2023) covers a defined list of eligible nationalities for tourism, business, humanitarian, and some other purposes; other nationalities need a consular visa with a formal invitation.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a consular tourist visa with an invitation (tourist voucher or MVD-registered invitation letter) if not e-visa eligible.

requirements.blocker_text: Covers tourism and short business/humanitarian visits; does not authorise employment.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the relevant work route instead if the purpose is employment.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid at least 6 months beyond the visa period
Online e-visa application, or a tourist voucher/invitation letter registered with the MVD for consular visas

outcome.duration_length: e-visa: up to 16 days per stay; consular tourist visa: typically up to 30 days

sources.title: Novika -- Russia Visa 2026: Application, E-Visa, Cost & Times, describing the unified e-visa system introduced August 2023 and consular visa requirements

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of mid.ru (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) or the evisa.kdmid.ru portal was achieved in this research pass -- this route rests on a well cross-referenced tier-3 travel-guide source. Kept as published rather than draft because the e-visa system's general shape (16-day cap, defined eligible-country list, August 2023 launch) is stable and consistent across every source checked, though a follow-up session should attempt a direct government fetch for the specific eligible-country list. Context worth noting factually rather than editorially: direct flight connections between Russia and several Western countries have been suspended since February 2022, and multiple Western foreign ministries maintain travel advisories against travel to Russia -- these don't change visa issuance itself, which multiple sources confirm remains procedurally operational, but do affect practical routing and are worth surfacing for trip-planning purposes.
